findings.message: Codex review of TASK-038 confirms all acceptance criteria are met. CI quality gate implementation is complete with domain isolation, prompt regression, and safety red-team suites.

Domain isolation gate via check-domain-isolation.sh properly scans domain code for forbidden runtime/network patterns. Forbidden patterns include scene classes, HTTP/network APIs, and filesystem/runtime adapter references.

Prompt regression gate via run_prompt_regression_tests.gd loads fixtures from data/ai/prompt_regression_fixtures.json and verifies template resolution and kid locale guard (en-US -> pl-PL). Runner script run-prompt-regression.sh executes the tests.

Safety red-team gate via run_safety_redteam_tests.gd includes adversarial checks: unsafe text moderation, kid disallowed-tool rejection (script_edit), unsafe voice transcript blocking. Runner script run-safety-gates.sh executes the suite.
Unified quality gates script executes all individual gates plus focused baseline suites (TASK-027, TASK-032). This provides comprehensive local validation before CI.
GitHub Actions workflow .github/workflows/quality-gates.yml is properly configured with pull_request and push triggers to main/master. Uses firebelley/setup-godot@v1 for Godot installation.
Local validation confirms all gates passed successfully. Domain isolation, prompt regression, safety red-team, and unified quality gates all executed without failures.
Handoff documentation (TASK-038-handoff-to-claude.md) is comprehensive, documenting all implementation details, validation results, and acceptance criteria mapping.

summary: APPROVE. TASK-038 implementation and codex review are both complete and correct. CI quality gate scaffolding is fully operational with domain isolation, prompt regression, and safety red-team suites integrated into GitHub Actions. All acceptance criteria are met.
